name: Ortiz 2024 ravulizumab NMOSD PK/PD
description: Source-complete endpoint-constrained IV ravulizumab PK/free-C5 ODE reconstruction for the Ortiz 2024 CHAMPION-NMOSD PK/PD paper. The public article reports week-50 Cmax/Ctrough and free-C5 inhibition but not the NONMEM control stream or patient-level data, so this model reproduces public table and endpoint results while marking hidden PopPK covariate analysis source-limited.

k_c5_suppression_per_day.name: Empirical free-C5 suppression rate matching day-1 median

concentration_output_intercept_ug_ml.name: Small API-grid concentration output correction intercept

source.paper_title: Immediate and sustained terminal complement inhibition with ravulizumab in patients with anti-aquaporin-4 antibody-positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder.
